I am also weighing whether any trade could help me avoid those dangerous landings or raise enough cash.

I need $274 more liquidity to survive the orange rent. Trading States Avenue for their pink monopoly would not help, since they already hold St. Charles and Virginia and that trade would give them more kill squares.

I am now evaluating other trade offers. Ventnor would complete the yellow monopoly, but that would add more death squares rather than help me survive. Mediterranean would complete brown with Baltic, yet brown is too weak to save me from orange. Water Works would give them a utility pair, though they would need to unmortgage Electric Company first. Pacific and North Carolina would complete the green monopoly, which is deadly.

Railroad monopolies are not viable trade targets because neither side owns a full set. I cannot force the opponent to sell houses through a trade, and they would never trade their orange properties with four houses for cash.

I considered offering a large cash payment to survive the orange rent, but the opponent has only $141 and would need to mortgage or sell assets to pay me. They would not give away survival money when they can simply wait for me to land on orange and win.

I will keep my houses as emergency liquidity for the upcoming red rent of $250. Building now would waste cash I might need for that charge. Unmortgaging Mediterranean is a poor idea because it costs $33 to unmortgage and yields only $2 or $4 in rent without a monopoly. Reading Railroad unmortgages for $110, which is slightly more than its $100 mortgage value.

Unmortgaging any of my mortgaged properties would cost more than the rent they generate. Reading Railroad and Pennsylvania Railroad each cost $110 to unmortgage for only $25 in rent. States Avenue, Ventnor Avenue, and Water Works are similarly poor deals. Pacific Avenue costs $165 to unmortgage for just $40 in rent. None of these options are worth the cash.

I will end my turn. Selling houses now would give me $316, but I am checking whether that extra cash could fund any other move.

I checked the opponent's next possible landings from Indiana Avenue. They will not land on any of my light blue properties, so selling my houses now would lose rent opportunities without preventing a future orange hit.
